name: What is NF2? (condition overview)
summary: Plain-language explainer of NF2 and its main health risks, with pages by body area (tumours, eyes, cranial nerves, spine, peripheral nerves).
access: Text-only pages, so they work for readers with hearing loss.

name: Treatment options hub
summary: Overview of surgery, radiation, drug treatments and hearing implants, with a sub-page for each.

name: NF2 treatment centres list
summary: List of centres that treat NF2.
access: Check each centre's details directly: list is volunteer-maintained.

name: Hearing implants (ABI / cochlear)
summary: Explains hearing implant options for people with NF2.

name: Genetics & family planning
summary: How NF2 is inherited, plus a related family-planning page.

name: NF2 Crew (online peer community)
summary: Online support community for people with NF2 and their families. CHOP's NF2 Crew page now redirects here.
access: Online and text-based, so suits deaf users.

name: NF2-SWN overview & resources
summary: CTF's main NF2-SWN page: what it is, treatments, and links to clinics and resources.

name: Diagnosed with NF2-SWN guide (2024)
summary: Booklet for newly and previously diagnosed people: genetics, symptoms, treatment, how diagnosis works, research, getting involved.

name: NF2-SWN fact sheet
summary: One-page summary. Covers the 2022 renaming to NF2-SWN and how common it is. Handy to give to others.

name: Find a Doctor / NF Clinic Network
summary: List of NF specialty clinics. CTF advises choosing ones that see many NF2-SWN patients.

name: NF Resource Library
summary: Library of brochures, fact sheets, infographics and webinars, including some Spanish versions.

name: NF Registry
summary: Patient-entered registry that matches people to clinical trials and shares de-identified data with researchers. Open to NF1, NF2-SWN and SWN.
access: Online form. Adults enrol themselves; parents enrol children.

name: Progress in NF2-SWN research (INTUITT-NF2)
summary: Plain-language update on CTF-funded research, including the INTUITT-NF2 platform trial.

name: INTUITT-NF2 trial record (NCT04374305)
summary: Official record of the multi-drug platform trial for progressive NF2-SWN tumours (ages 12+).

name: Brigatinib results press release (2024)
summary: Lay summary of the 2024 NEJM result: brigatinib shrank some NF2-SWN tumours, and some patients reported better hearing and less pain.

name: NCCN guideline inclusion of brigatinib (commentary)
summary: Oct 2026 interview on the INTUITT-NF2 findings and brigatinib's inclusion in NCCN guidance.

name: 2022 diagnostic criteria & nomenclature (Plotkin et al.)
summary: International consensus that updated the diagnostic criteria (including mosaic forms) and retired the name 'neurofibromatosis 2'.

name: GeneReviews: NF2
summary: Clinician reference on diagnosis, genetics, inheritance and management.

name: MedlinePlus Genetics: NF2
summary: Plain-language genetics summary (the NF2 gene and the merlin protein).

name: NORD rare disease report: NF2-SWN
summary: Full disease report with a trials section. Last updated Feb 2023.

name: NF2-SWN & Hearing webinar
summary: Specialist talk on hearing preservation and restoration, plus a lived-experience panel on ASL, lip-reading, assistive tech, service dogs and home safety.

name: Beyond Sound: communication workshop
summary: In-person workshop on communication strategies for deaf and hard-of-hearing people with NF2-SWN (held Nov 2025).
access: Past event; good model for content.

name: Acoustic Neuroma Association (ANA)
summary: Peer mentors, discussion forum, support groups, and links on hearing, balance and NF2.

name: Mayo Clinic NF2 Clinic (Arizona)
summary: Multidisciplinary NF2 clinic with annual follow-ups and access to trials. A model of coordinated care.

name: NHS: NF2 overview
summary: Official NHS overview with links to Nerve Tumours UK support for adults, teenagers and parents.

name: Nerve Tumours UK Helpline
summary: Phone and email helpline run by specialist NF advisers. Freephone 0300 102 17 22, Mon/Wed/Fri 9am–5pm.
access: Email option for people who can't use the phone.

name: Support for adults with NF2
summary: Lived-experience tips, plus specialists who help with referrals and appointment coordination. Links to NF Masterclass videos.

name: NF2 support booklet for adults
summary: Adult guide to living with NF2, with patient quotes and an overview of specialist support.

name: Support for Medics (NF2)
summary: GP and clinician primer, plus sign-up to a gated medical resources section.

name: Support for Employers (NF2)
summary: How to support an employee with NF2, with pointers to workplace hearing-loss advice.

name: How to use Lipspeakers (video)
summary: Demonstration of lipspeaking by a speech therapist who worked in an NF2 team.

name: Accessible online meetings (CART / captions)
summary: Lip-reading and live captioning (CART) for video calls. Relevant to telehealth.

name: Oxford NF2 service (South West)
summary: One of four national NF2 centres (with Cambridge, London, Manchester). Satellite clinics in Bristol, Plymouth and Southampton.

name: Oxford NF2 support & useful links
summary: Nurse practitioners (help with forms, benefits and communicating in clinic) and links on hearing loss, tinnitus, jobs and benefits.
access: Nurses help with communication at appointments.

name: Cambridge NF2 service (Midlands/Eastern)
summary: National NF2 centre with a monthly MDT clinic, neurology, hearing implants and clinical psychology.
access: Has a psychologist in the team.

name: Manchester NF2 clinic
summary: Regional specialist NF2 assessment and management centre.

name: Guy's & St Thomas' NF2 clinic (London)
org: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS FT
summary: London NF2 schwannomatosis clinic, Monday and Wednesday.
access: Takes texts on its mobile line, which suits deaf patients.

name: Hearing Link Services (incl. NF2 programme)
org: Hearing Link / Hearing Dogs for Deaf People
summary: Support for adults with acquired hearing loss and their families. Has run an NF2-specific residential rehab programme.
access: Confirm the NF2 programme is still running.

name: British Acoustic Neuroma Association (BANA)
summary: Information and in-person and virtual support groups for acoustic neuroma and related conditions.

name: Rare Resources guides
summary: Guides on getting a rare diagnosis, using the NHS, and support for parents and carers (England, Scotland, Wales).

name: The Brain Charity: acoustic neuroma support
summary: Counselling, befriending, practical help and free carer support for neurological conditions, including NF2.

name: CTF Australia support coordinator
summary: National NF support service. Tel 02 9713 6111, support@ctf.org.au, Mon–Fri 9am–5pm AEST.

name: Understanding NF2 brochure (AU)
summary: Australian NF2 overview covering surgery, radiosurgery, radiotherapy and hearing rehabilitation.

name: CTF AU resources & webinars
summary: Fact sheets, toolkits and health-management kits, plus quarterly expert webinars.

name: CTF AU Navigate Care
summary: CTF AU's care-navigation section.

name: CTF AU Connect with Others
summary: CTF AU's peer-connection programs.

name: RNSH Neurofibromatosis Clinic (Sydney)
summary: Diagnostic service for adults and children with NF1, NF2 and SWN. Described as NSW's specialised adult NF service. The link is the referral criteria.

name: Royal Melbourne Hospital adult NF clinic
summary: Adult NF clinic with a clinical nurse specialist. No public patient page found yet.
access: Ask CTF AU for the referral pathway.

name: RARE Portal & RARE Helpline
summary: Government-funded Australian rare disease portal, plus a helpline staffed by people trained in psychology and social work.

name: Hearing Australia: complex hearing needs (CSO)
summary: Sole provider of government-funded services for people with severe or profound loss or complex communication needs, and young adults under 26.

name: NDIS hearing supports
summary: How the NDIS can fund hearing supports beyond the Hearing Services Program.

name: Acoustic Neuroma Association Australia
summary: Support and information since 1984 for people facing treatment for acoustic neuroma or other benign cranial tumours.

name: Malaysian Rare Disorders Society (MRDS)
summary: National rare disease society. Supports informal patient groups, including for neurofibromatosis.
